en: This sepia-toned postcard shows a large group of children and a few adults (likely priests and teachers) gathered in front of an ornate iron fence and stone gate. Behind the fence, there is a building that resembles a church or a school, and a visible cross at the top of the gate suggests a religious context. The children are dressed in formal attire, possibly for a religious ceremony such as First Communion. The scene is shaded by large trees.
